name: Locked folder
description: A private folder of videos behind its own passcode, for the admin on the owner profile: thumbnails, private resume, and nothing in history, search, stats or Now playing.

env.name: VAULT_DIR
env.description: Folder inside the container holding the locked videos (e.g. /Locked). Never inside MEDIA_ROOTS or a library folder. Needs the .cinema-root marker file.

env.name: VAULT_AUTOLOCK_MIN
env.description: Minutes without activity before the folder locks again (default 10). A video open in the player keeps it unlocked.
